### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are reported for the Japanese and Korean PDF font fallback changes. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #19918 by adding font-style fallbacks so PDF exports containing Japanese or Korean text can handle italic and bold italic runs without missing-font errors. **Changes:** - Maps italic text to Regular and bold italic text to Bold for both NotoSansJp and NotoSansKr, matching the existing Geologica fallback. - Adds regression tests checking both fallback mappings for Japanese and Korean language selections. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `opencti-platform/​opencti-front/​src/​utils/​htmlToPdf/​utils/​pdfFonts.ts` | Adds italic and bold italic mappings using existing font assets. | | `opencti-platform/​opencti-front/​src/​utils/​htmlToPdf/​utils/​pdfFonts.test.ts` | Verifies fallback mappings for both language selections. |
Review effort: Balanced
